name: TurboProxy
description: High-speed HTTP and SOCKS5 residential & datacenter proxy solutions

knowledge_base.title: How to configure SOCKS5 Proxy
knowledge_base.content: To connect via SOCKS5: Host: proxy.turboproxy.com, Port: 1080. Enter your assigned username and password or whitelist your server IP in dashboard.

knowledge_base.title: Refund Policy & Bandwidth Usage
knowledge_base.content: Refunds are granted within 48 hours of initial purchase if less than 500MB of bandwidth has been consumed.

knowledge_base.title: Rotating vs Sticky Sessions
knowledge_base.content: Sticky sessions hold an IP address for 10 to 30 minutes, ideal for account management. Rotating mode assigns a brand new IP address on every single HTTP request.
